clue.text: Cause to tumble down hill — that's cruel

definitions.meaning: first meaning: to bring down, as a tree is cut down; it is also a northern English word for a hill
second meaning: an old literary adjective for fierce or savage

explanation.surface: Pushing someone down a slope would be a cruel thing to do.
explanation.walkthrough: The first part works twice over: to make something tumble down, and a hill in the Lake District sense, so the word carries three senses in all.
explanation.definitionFit: The verb means knock or cut down, the noun is a northern upland, and the archaic adjective means ferocious.

clue.text: Part of motorist's route that's shortened by removing tree

definitions.text: Part of motorist's route that's shortened by removing tree

parts.note: surface reading: a stretch of road a driver uses, cut short by clearing away timber
setter's reading: take the four letters of a tree out of the road word and what is left is its standard two-letter abbreviation

explanation.surface: A section of a driver's road is made shorter when a fallen tree is cleared.
explanation.walkthrough: Take TREE out of STREET and ST remains, which is exactly how the word is shortened on maps and addresses.
explanation.definitionFit: A town road along which motorists drive is a thoroughfare, abbreviated ST in addresses.

clue.text: Garden party VIP in 50s

definitions.meaning: first meaning: the biblical paradise garden of Adam and Eve
second meaning: Sir Anthony, Conservative leader and Prime Minister in the 1950s

explanation.surface: An important guest at a 1950s garden party.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Garden party' reads as one phrase, but it splits: the garden is one meaning, and the party is the Conservative Party, led by Anthony Eden, UK Prime Minister 1955-57.
explanation.definitionFit: The Bible's first garden shares its name with the Tory leader who was British premier during the Suez crisis.

clue.text: Saying area produces greatest possible amounts

parts.note: a maxim is a proverb or saying
A is the abbreviation for area

explanation.surface: A proverb about land producing the biggest harvests.
explanation.definitionFit: Maxima is the Latin plural of maximum, the upper limits or highest values.

clue.text: Under pressure, son prepared to perform

parts.note: S is the abbreviation for son
someone trained has been prepared to do a job or act

explanation.surface: A boy rehearsed for his performance and felt the stress.
explanation.definitionFit: Strained describes something tense or stressed, as when a relationship or a rope is stretched hard.

clue.text: I called cop improperly for minor offence

indicators.note: done improperly means done wrongly, so the letters are put in the wrong order

parts.note: the letters of these three words, taken as written

explanation.surface: Someone confesses to wrongly phoning the police over something trivial.
explanation.definitionFit: A peccadillo is a small sin or trifling fault, from the Spanish for little sin.

clue.text: Granted it's extremely good? Outstanding

parts.note: the best is the superlative of good
a debt still outstanding is one owed

explanation.surface: Someone agrees a thing is really excellent, even exceptional.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Outstanding' looks like praise to match 'extremely good', but it is the unpaid-debt sense.
explanation.definitionFit: To bestow is to confer or give, so granted and bestowed are past-tense synonyms.

clue.text: Observer reformatted its news?

indicators.note: reformatted text has been laid out afresh, so the letters take a new arrangement

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: A newspaper, the Observer, has redesigned the layout of its news pages.
explanation.walkthrough: The Observer is a British Sunday newspaper, which suits the talk of formatting news, but here the word means an onlooker.
explanation.definitionFit: A witness is a person who sees an event, an onlooker or bystander.

clue.text: Part of plant — here it is

indicators.note: 'here it is' points at the run of letters in front of the solver, sitting inside the words

parts.note: found inside, spanning the two words

explanation.surface: Pointing out a piece of a plant: here it is.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Part of' does double duty: it is the start of the definition and it also tells you the answer is part of the following letters.
explanation.definitionFit: The anther is the pollen-bearing tip of a flower's stamen.

clue.text: German prince warning about British

indicators.note: about means surrounding, so one word goes around the other

parts.note: an alert is a warning
B is the abbreviation for British

explanation.surface: A German prince cautions someone about the British.
explanation.walkthrough: Prince Albert of Saxe-Coburg and Gotha was Queen Victoria's husband.
explanation.definitionFit: Queen Victoria's consort was a prince born in the German duchy of Saxe-Coburg.

clue.text: Doctor I can sue about new pain in neck

indicators.note: about means around, so the rearranged letters wrap the next piece
to doctor is to tamper with or falsify, so the letters are altered in order

parts.note: taken as written
N is the abbreviation for new

explanation.surface: A patient threatens to take the doctor to court over a fresh neck pain.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Doctor' looks like a person being sued, but it is a verb telling you to mix the letters.
explanation.definitionFit: A pain in the neck is an idiom for an annoying person or thing, which is what a nuisance is.

clue.text: Bartender's act I misconstrued as disorganised

indicators.note: misconstrued means wrongly interpreted, so the letters are read in a wrong order

parts.note: taken as written, the apostrophe dropped

explanation.surface: Someone admits they wrongly took a barman's performance for chaos.
explanation.definitionFit: A scatterbrained person is forgetful and muddled, unable to keep things in order.

clue.text: Conservative and socialist on one board? That's praiseworthy

parts.note: C is the abbreviation for Conservative
red is a common term for a left-winger
I is the Roman numeral for one
board means a table, as in bed and board

explanation.surface: Politicians of right and left sitting together on a single committee is to be applauded.
explanation.walkthrough: 'On' just places the pieces in sequence; 'board' is the old sense of a dining table.
explanation.definitionFit: Creditable means deserving credit or approval, so it is a synonym of commendable.

clue.text: Crossed lines in historical enemy fighter

indicators.note: in means placed within, so one piece sits inside the other

parts.note: the Boers fought the British in South Africa around 1900
two lines crossing form an X

explanation.surface: A fighter from an old enemy army stepped over the battle lines.
explanation.walkthrough: The Boer Wars were Britain's wars against Dutch-descended settlers in southern Africa.
explanation.definitionFit: A boxer is someone who fights with fists in a ring, a pugilist.

clue.text: Place for eating dog's breakfast

definitions.meaning: first meaning: a military dining hall, as in the officers' one
second meaning: a muddle or shambles

explanation.walkthrough: A dog's breakfast is British slang for a chaotic jumble, though the surface makes it sound like a pet's meal in a canteen.
explanation.definitionFit: The noun names both a forces canteen and an untidy, chaotic state of affairs.

clue.text: Shift to right or left that is seen in some extreme parties, primarily

indicators.note: something seen in another is placed within it
primarily means first of all, so just the opening letter of each word counts

parts.note: initial letters of the three words
id est is the Latin phrase behind the abbreviation i.e.

explanation.surface: A political move away from the centre visible in a few radical parties.
explanation.walkthrough: 'That is' gives not IE but the full Latin it abbreviates, id est. The surface makes 'right or left' sound political.
explanation.definitionFit: To sidestep is to step sideways, dodging one way or the other.

clue.text: Beaten by five or ten in this upset

indicators.note: in means placed within, so one letter goes inside the others
upset means knocked over, so the letters are tipped into disorder

parts.note: taken as written
X is the Roman numeral for ten

explanation.surface: A sporting upset in which a team lost by a five or ten point margin.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Beaten by five' sounds like a score margin, but it means beaten by five competitors.
explanation.definitionFit: The one who finishes sixth has five others ahead, so is beaten by five rivals.

clue.text: With assistance, grasped cutting tool

parts.note: to give a hand is to help
saw means understood, grasped an idea

explanation.surface: Someone got help and took hold of a blade.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Grasped' suggests gripping the tool, but here it means understood.
explanation.definitionFit: A handsaw is a saw worked by one hand, a woodworking tool for cutting.

clue.text: Plant copied down as part of intersecting answer

wordplay.note: the down answer crossing here, PECCADILLO, holds these four letters

explanation.surface: A herb's name was transcribed as part of a cross-reference.
explanation.walkthrough: The fodder is not in the clue but in the grid: the 6-down answer PECCADILLO crosses this one and contains DILL, so the letters are copied from that down entry.
explanation.definitionFit: Dill is an aromatic herb with feathery leaves, used with fish and in pickling.

clue.text: Condition and train in certain way to produce this?

definitions.text: Condition and train in certain way to produce this?

indicators.note: in a certain way means arranged in some other manner, so the letters are rearranged

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: Conditioning and training people in a fixed way leads to brainwashing.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue is the definition too: conditioning and training people to think in a set way is just what the answer means.
explanation.definitionFit: Indoctrination is teaching someone to accept beliefs uncritically, a kind of mental conditioning.

clue.text: Clubs, sweetheart, in which we can live luxuriously

definitions.text: in which we can live luxuriously
definitions.note: the answer is the plant in the idiom to live in clover

parts.note: C is the abbreviation for clubs, the card suit
a lover is a sweetheart

explanation.surface: Nightclubs and a lover: the good life.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition leans on the idiom 'to live in clover', meaning to live in comfort.
explanation.definitionFit: Living in clover is an idiom for an easy prosperous life, like cattle grazing in rich pasture.

clue.text: Jerk seen in West End with charming female

indicators.note: the end of a word is its final letter, so only that one is kept

parts.note: final letter
a witch casts charms, that is, spells

explanation.surface: A creep spotted in London's West End with an attractive woman.
explanation.walkthrough: London's West End is the theatre district, but here 'End' just means the last letter of West; 'charming' means spell-casting.
explanation.definitionFit: A twitch is a sudden involuntary jerk of a muscle.

clue.text: Supporter in pub rules out screwdriver, say

parts.note: to bar is to exclude, rule out
a screwdriver is an example of a tool

explanation.surface: A pub forbids a screwdriver, perhaps meaning the cocktail.
explanation.walkthrough: A screwdriver is also a vodka and orange cocktail, which suits the pub, but here it is just a workman's implement.
explanation.definitionFit: A bar stool is a tall seat that holds up a drinker at a pub counter.

clue.text: Left single and solitary

parts.note: L is the abbreviation for left
single means one

explanation.surface: Someone abandoned, unattached and alone.
explanation.definitionFit: Lone means being by oneself, without companions, as in a lone wolf.

clue.text: Take part in investing, yet reluctant to spend money

indicators.note: taking part of the next words means pulling a run of letters out from within them

parts.note: found inside, spanning the two words

explanation.surface: Someone joins in a share purchase while being tight with cash.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Take part in' reads as joining in, but it means take a part of the following words.
explanation.definitionFit: Stingy means mean or miserly, unwilling to spend or give.

clue.text: Call for silence supporting game? I'm amazed!

indicators.note: in a down entry, the supporting piece is underneath, so it comes second

parts.note: Go is the Japanese board game
the hushing sound used to call for quiet

explanation.surface: Someone is startled when spectators are told to hush during a match.
explanation.definitionFit: Gosh is a mild exclamation of surprise, a minced form of God.

clue.text: Judge's conclusion following adjustment of legal claim

indicators.note: following means coming after, so this piece goes at the end
an adjustment changes something's arrangement, so these letters are rearranged

parts.note: taken as written

indicators.note: a word's conclusion is its final letter, which alone is kept

parts.note: final letter

explanation.surface: A judge's ruling after a legal claim was amended.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Legal claim' reads as one phrase, but 'legal' is the fodder and 'claim' the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: To allege is to assert something, usually without proof yet, so it means to claim.

clue.text: Source of information from every quarter found

parts.note: the four compass points, north, east, west and south
to found metal is to cast it in a mould

explanation.surface: Information gathered from all directions was discovered.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Found' looks like the past tense of find, but it is the verb meaning to cast metal.
explanation.definitionFit: A newscast is a broadcast bulletin that informs viewers or listeners about current events.
